turns.t: Mr Teague? Ben? I'm Kim, the nurse, I'll do your obs while we wait. You've got a bump there. ~
It's nothing. I stood up under a door frame, that's all. I've a job to finish. ~
Blood pressure 134 over 82, pulse 76, temperature 36.7, oxygen 99 percent, respiratory rate 16.
Hello, Ben, I'm Dr Lawson. I'll be quick, but I'd like you to tell me the whole story. What happened? ~
Carpenter's mistake. I was kneeling, stood up and caught my forehead on a steel door frame. Hard.
Did you black out, or lose consciousness, even for a second?
No. I was dizzy for about a minute, saw stars, and then it went away.
And how are you feeling now?
Headache, a dull one, at the front. And a lump, which hurts.
Have you been sick since?
No, no sickness.
Any memory gap, where you can't remember what happened? ~
No. I remember it all, unfortunately. ~
Allergies to medicines?
Penicillin, rash.
And medical conditions?
Migraines, and asthma, mild.
Does anyone in your family have blood or brain problems?
My mother had a stroke, at seventy.
And your work, you're a carpenter, any heavy machinery?
Yes, a lot, which is why I want to get back.
Let me examine you. Look at my finger. ~
Right.
There's a swollen, tender lump about three centimetres on the right of your forehead, the skin is intact, your pupils are equal and react normally, and your eye movements and balance are normal.
GCS is fifteen, doctor. ~
Thanks, Kim. Ben, I'm not going to send you for a scan, because you don't have any of the warning signs, and your examination is normal. ~
Good. ~
This looks like a minor head injury, with a bruise to the forehead.
Can I go back to work? ~
Not on the saws or at height today. Rest, ice the lump for twenty minutes every few hours, and take paracetamol if the headache troubles you.
I'll manage. ~
Someone should stay with you tonight, Ben. ~
My wife will be home at six. ~
Good. ~
Come back or call 999 if you become very drowsy, vomit repeatedly, have a fit, develop worsening headache, confusion, or clear fluid from the nose or ears.
Understood. Thanks, both. ~
